DUPLICATE_ACCOUNT.en: An account with email '{email}' already exists

ACTIVE_SESSION_CONFLICT.en: There is an active session for world {world_id}. Log out first.

SESSION_NOT_ACTIVE.en: No active session — run login first

OVERVIEW_PAGE_NOT_LOADED.es: La página '{page}' de Travian no cargó a tiempo (world_id={world_id}). Inténtalo de nuevo.
OVERVIEW_PAGE_NOT_LOADED.en: Travian page '{page}' did not load in time (world_id={world_id}). Please try again.
OVERVIEW_PAGE_NOT_LOADED.de: Die Travian-Seite '{page}' hat nicht rechtzeitig geladen (world_id={world_id}). Bitte erneut versuchen.

LOGIN_FAILED.es: Login fallido para '{username}'. Verifica las credenciales o el estado del servidor.
LOGIN_FAILED.en: Login failed for '{username}'. Check your credentials or server status.
